Project: Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company, PBC – 
 MCCPDC - SCADA and PCS MISC. PLC System 
 
Functional Specification for the MCCPDC - SCADA and PCS MISC. PLC System  
 
 
ID code: 215115305 -FS (V1.2) Page 9 of 58 
© 2022 Rockwell Automation, Inc. All Rights Reserved / Author: Buol, Scott 
2 Project Overview 
Key Objectives and Benefits 
The Dallas, TX M3 Fill Finish Line owned by Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company, PBC is a 
pharmaceutical production line adhering to FDA requirements.  
The new SCADA and PCS Misc. PLC system that will be installed in the M3 Fill Finish Line at Mark 
Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company, PBC, performs limited control, collects environmental data, and 
collects data from six production machines.  The SCADA and PCS Misc. PLC system will interface with 
the production machines and their various brands of PLCs.  
The SCADA system hardware consists of the following server and clients: 
 PCS Physical Servers: located in the Data Room (Room 056, Grid: C1-C2). 
 Client 1: Engineering Workstation PC located in Room 054 Grid: A4. 
 Client 2: Touchscreen PC used for operator interaction with associated PLC panel for 
control located in Utilities Room (Room 035 Grid: B2). 
 Client 3 (Group): Wireless Tablet PCs used for operator interaction with the process 
located within wireless coverage area on the site. 
The supervisory software will be deli vered and configured by  MAVERICK Technologies.   All servers and 
clients’ hardware will be installed and connected to the network by Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug 
Company, PBC.  The communication between the server and the Ethernet distribution switch in the Data Room will be established through copper Ethernet cabling and from there, local Ethernet cabling will connect the different clients and PLC’s.  The wireless tablet PCs will connect to the servers in the Data Room via wireless access points throughout the facility.   
Project Assumptions, Conventions and Limitations 
This document assumes that the Customer has a basic understanding of, and familiarity with Rockwell 
Automation’s FactoryTalk View Site Edition (SE) functionality. 
The following limitations and assumptions are known: 
1. Per RFI-001, the recipe system requirements do not apply to the SCADA and PCS MISC. 
PLC System. 
2. In the September 14, 2021 meeting, MC CPDC approved a change from NEMA 4X to 
NEMA 12 since the panel is now located in a general use, non-washdown area.  UR4.5.2 
[URS-PCS-HR-014] Electrical enclosures shall be washdown duty, NEMA 4X rated no longer applies.  The chosen panel with rating of NEMA 4 exceeds the rating requirement of NEMA 12, thus satisfying the requirement.
